name: markdown-editor-hardened
description: A security-hardened WYSIWYG editor for markdown. Fork of zaaack.markdown-editor with: enableCommandUris removed (closes RCE via crafted markdown command: URIs), customCss XSS vector removed, localResourceRoots scoped, CSP added, jsdelivr CDN dependency removed (vditor + Lute bundled locally), vditor bumped to 3.11.x.

markdown-editor-hardened.imageSaveFolder.description: Save images to which folder when upload in markdown, default relative to the markdown file, you can set to project root via `${projectRoot}/assets`.

markdown-editor-hardened.useVscodeThemeC.description: Use vscode theme's background color as the markdown editor's background color.

markdown-editor-hardened.showLineNumbers.description: Show line numbers in the left gutter of the markdown editor. Each number is the block-start line within the editor's current markdown text (not rendered-output lines), paired with a rendered block in order. Note: vditor re-serializes the document — it drops blank lines after YAML frontmatter, inserts them between adjacent blocks and collapses runs — so numbers can differ from the file on disk by several lines, most visibly below a frontmatter block. Adapted for CSP from upstream PR #157 — credit asalcedo29.

markdown-editor-hardened.defaultOpenOutl.description: Open the outline by default when opening a markdown editor.

markdown-editor-hardened.customStyleshee.description: Workspace-relative path to a .css file to load into the editor webview. Replaces upstream's `customCss` (which interpolated arbitrary HTML into a <style> block — XSS vector). Examples: `styles/editor.css`, `.vscode/markdown-editor.css`. The path must resolve to a file INSIDE the workspace, must end in `.css`, and cannot use absolute paths or URLs (data:, https://, etc. are all rejected). Empty = no custom stylesheet.

scripts.pub: foy build && npm version patch && git push origin master --tags && vsce package && vsce publish
